zh.title: 接收完成事件，不等于验收完成证据：状态服务的九个探针
zh.summary: 固定示例中的完成事件可在治理仍阻止时被接收；有效拒绝对照也存在。九个本地请求说明报告、身份授权与业务执行需要分开核验。

en.title: A Completion Event Is Not Completion Evidence: Nine Probes of an ASP Example
en.summary: The pinned example accepted an evidence-free completion while governance remained blocked. Nine loopback requests, including effective rejection controls, distinguish reporting from caller authority and effect enforcement.
